subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Listening 3.2.1, conditional practice and the island puzzle
outcomes: Listen to a travel agent and choose the correct information
Write first conditional sentences and solve a puzzle with them
Scan a text about the most visited countries for key information

tf.s: In the listening, Salima is celebrating her wedding anniversary.
tf.why: Salima wants a trip for her wedding anniversary.

tf.s: The CN Tower is over 550 metres high.
tf.why: The listening says the CN Tower is over 550 m.

tf.s: On the EdgeWalk, people walk inside the tower near the restaurant.
tf.why: The EdgeWalk goes outside, around the top of the tower.

tf.s: In the puzzle, the man has a cat, a dog and some fish.
tf.why: He must move all three to the island by boat.

tf.s: The man can take everything together safely in one trip.
tf.why: The dog would eat the cat, or the cat would eat the fish.

tf.s: The first step of the solution is to take the cat and the fish to the island.
tf.why: That is how the solution starts.

tf.s: The report about the most visited countries was published by the World Tourism Organisation.
tf.why: The text names the World Tourism Organisation.

tf.s: Scanning means reading every word slowly and carefully.
tf.why: Scanning means looking quickly for specific information.

tf.s: The Alhambra Palace mentioned in the text is in Italy.
tf.why: The Alhambra Palace is in Spain.

tf.s: A key word in a question can guide you to the part of the text with the answer.
tf.why: Key words help you scan to the right place.

hunt.q: The walk around the tower top
One of the most visited countries

mcq.q: Who does Salima talk to in Listening 3.2.1?
mcq.why: She asks a travel agent to help plan her trip.

mcq.q: What does the man have with him in the puzzle?
o: A cat, a dog and some fish
A cat, a horse and a bird
mcq.why: He must move a cat, a dog and fish to the island.

mcq.q: Which countries are among the most visited in the text?
mcq.why: The text names France, Spain and Italy.

o: A word in the question that leads you to the answer in the text
The longest word in a text
A word you must learn by heart
mcq.why: Key words help you find the answer quickly.

mcq.q: Make a first conditional: visit Dubai / see the tallest building.
o: If you visit Dubai, you'll see the tallest building in the world.
If you will visit Dubai, you see the tallest building.
If you visited Dubai, you see the tallest building.
You visit Dubai if you'll see the tallest building.
mcq.why: If + present simple, will + base verb.

mcq.q: You need to find the name of a palace in a long text. What should you do?
mcq.why: Scanning for a key word finds specific facts quickly.

mcq.q: Choose the correct verb: 'If you ___ to see wild animals, you should take a boat trip.'
mcq.why: The if clause uses the present simple: want.

mcq.q: Why can't the man take the cat, dog and fish together?
o: The dog would eat the cat, or the cat would eat the fish
The fish cannot go in a boat
mcq.why: Some animals cannot be left together safely.

mcq.q: After taking the cat and fish across, why does the man bring the cat back?
o: So the cat is not left alone with the fish
Because the dog wants to swim
mcq.why: Bringing the cat back keeps the fish safe while he fetches the dog.

mcq.q: Why should you read the options before you listen?
o: You know what information to listen for
The options tell you every answer
mcq.why: Reading first helps you focus on the key information.
